pages.title: Our Mission
pages.content:
MeridianMatters exists to deliver clear, fast, accurate reporting across global news, sports, health, and finance.

We believe good journalism should be direct and free of noise — no clickbait, no filler, just the story and the context you need to understand it.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Have a tip, correction, or question? Reach out any time.

Email: hello@meridianmatters.example

We read every message, though response times may vary.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
MeridianMatters respects your privacy. This site does not sell personal data.

Standard web analytics may be used to understand overall traffic patterns. No personally identifying information is collected beyond what's necessary to operate the site.
